import random, time

def make(a):
    masks = [0]*256
    bit = 1
    for ch in a:
        masks[ch] |= bit
        bit <<= 1
    return masks

def v_dict(a,b):
    if len(a)>len(b): a,b=b,a
    m=len(a)
    if m==0: return 0
    masks={}
    bit=1
    for ch in a:
        masks[ch]=masks.get(ch,0)|bit
        bit<<=1
    full=(1<<m)-1
    V=full
    get=masks.get
    for ch in b:
        p=get(ch,0)
        if p:
            U=V&p
            V=(V+U)|(V-U)
    return m-(V&full).bit_count
